services.name: Tasting Notes
services.desc: (9-25 Guests) 90 Minutes - $25 per taster, $15 club members Friday and Saturday: 10 am, 12:30 pm, 2:30 pm Eberle's Group Tasting & Tour Experience includes a private cave tour and tasting flight of 5 wines hosted by one of our fabulous crew members. Group tastings are hosted on our Oak Knoll Patio and last approximately 90 minutes. While we define groups as parties of 9 - 20 people, any size party can opt to book a group tour and tasting by appointment & it is often recommended, especially if your party is looking for a more intimate experience here at Eberle. blurb: Eberle Winery is a family-owned producer and marketer of premium wines, representing the Eberle Estate, single varieties and designated vineyards. Eberle wines have showcased the history and diverse flavors of the Paso Robles Appellation since 1979. Gary Eberle grew up in a small town in Pennsylvania and went to Penn State on a football scholarship.
